name: CFM Indosuez Wealth Management SA
summary: CFM Indosuez Wealth Management SA, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of banking and financial solutions in Monaco and internationally. It primarily offers wealth management services to private investors, businesses, institutions, and professionals. The company was founded in 1922 and is based in Monaco. CFM Indosuez Wealth Management SA is a subsidiary of CA Indosuez Société anonyme.
